newsitem.title: USA: Bank of New York acquires Stanwich Benefits.
newsitem.headline: Bank of New York acquires Stanwich Benefits.

text.p: The Bank of New York Co Inc said Monday that it has acquired the assets of Stanwich Benefits Group Inc for an undisclosed sum.
Stanwich is a provider of actuarial, administrative and full service recordkeeping for employee benefit plans based in Purchase, N.Y.
The bank said that the purchase will enable it to expand its existing 401 (k) business to provide employee educational programs and full consulting and actuarial services.
The Bank of New York had $58 billion in assets at March 31.
